title: Fixer
subtitle: Independent
description: Back in the day, Fixer would hang out with his friends at the Tosche Station, including a young moisture farmer named Luke Skywalker. Luke would make his way off of Tatooine, but Fixer wouldn't. At the end of the Empire's reign, he still found himself at Tosche Station. One night, he found himself victim of a Nikto Biker gang, only to be saved by the notorious Boba Fett.
